title: 🔴🔴 Is World War III approaching?
text:
🔴🔴 Is World War III approaching?"

"Iran Official Warns War Could Spread Far Beyond Region—But Says He Won’t Invoke ‘World War III’ Yet"

"🔆🔅TEHRAN – November 3, 2026 – Hassan Ghashghavi, spokesperson for the Iranian Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, made the remarks in an interview."

"SOT1, Hassan Ghashghavi, National Security and Foreign Policy Commission (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:41): “If war begins and the enemy acts with malice, the geographic scope of the war will expand; all our enemies should take this seriously. I am not saying this as a threat. I speak as an informed speaker: the fire of war will spread far beyond the places and countries it has reached so far. That is, if we carry out operations, I do not want to use the term ‘World War III’ right now, but the geography of the war will expand, because everything the Supreme Leader has stated has come true so far.”"

"SOT2, Hassan Ghashghavi, National Security and Foreign Policy Commission (Farsi)-(00:42 - 00:58): “I can say this honestly to audiences inside and outside Iran, and I say it with knowledge: this war will be far more comprehensive and widespread than what it was in the 12-day war and the 40-day war.”"

"SOT3, Hassan Ghashghavi, National Security and Foreign Policy Commission (Farsi)-(00:00 - 01:19): “This is a directive [by Iran’s Supreme Leader]: they may be the initiator of the war, but the end… The end of the enemy’s evil is determined by us. We will not initiate any war; we are constantly in a state of defense. However, if a war does occur, the beginning will be theirs and the end will be ours.”
